body: Drake continues his birthday celebration by making it rain at a Houston strip club. The Boy was all the way turnt up over the weekend, as he hosted multiple parties to celebrate turning 40 on Oct. 24. On Monday (Oct. 26), the festivities continued, as Drizzy and crew popped out at Area 29 strip club in H-Town. Footage from the party shows the Canadian rap star enjoying the scenery and handling huge stacks of cash.

source_caption_text:
Drake continues his birthday celebration by making it rain at a Houston strip club.

The Boy was all the way turnt up over the weekend, as he hosted multiple parties to celebrate turning 40 on Oct. 24. On Monday (Oct. 26), the festivities continued, as Drizzy and crew popped out at Area 29 strip club in H-Town. Footage from the party shows the Canadian rap star enjoying the scenery and handling huge stacks of cash. Sexyy Red also showed up and partied with Drake, who was rumored to have thrown anywhere from $400,000 to upward of $1 million.
